prompts.q: Which is best: the swings, the slide, or the monkey bars?
rs: you can go very high
I almost touch the sky
the wind feels cool
my hair flies back
you learn to pump
I pump my legs to go
prompts.cl: no ride beats the swings

I laughed at the jokes
we can read them aloud
I read one to my class
they get kids reading

the glue is in its bin

prompts.q: Is it better to read a book or to listen to a story?

intro: Every school day has a time for recess.
topics.op: Recess is the best part of the school day.
rs: kids get to run and play outside
we race across the field
recess helps us make new friends
I met my friend Ana on the swings
we come back ready to learn
I can sit still and listen after I play
topics.close: No part of the day is better than recess.

intro: Each season of the year is different.
topics.op: Fall is the best season of all.
rs: the leaves change colors
maple leaves turn bright red
the weather is cool
we can play outside without getting hot
there are leaves to rake into piles
we can jump in the big piles we make
topics.close: No other season is as great as fall.

intro: Some schools have gardens.

topics.op: Our school should have a garden.

a garden would make our school prettier

topics.close: A garden would be a great thing for our school.

intro: Many birds live near our school.

owls have huge eyes

owls can fly without a sound
their soft feathers make almost no noise
topics.close: No other bird is as amazing as an owl.

intro: Kids play many games at recess.

two kids turn the rope and others jump

topics.close: No game at recess beats jump rope.

intro: Our playground has only two small trees.

intro: Spring comes after winter.

the trees are full of blossoms
cherry trees turn pink and white
the grass turns bright green
the field looks fresh and new
topics.close: No season is as pretty as spring.

a break helps us calm down
we can rest for a minute before math

intro: Kids can play inside or outside.
topics.op: Playing outside is better than playing inside.

we can race all the way to the fence
we can play in the fresh air
the air outside smells like grass
we can explore nature
we found a beetle under a rock
topics.close: Outside is the best place to play.

intro: Our classroom has many things.

topics.op: Our class should have a plant.

we can watch it grow
we could measure it each week
a plant makes a room look nice

intro: We have art class once a week.

art is relaxing

topics.close: Every school day should have time for art class.

intro: Some classes start the day with a morning meeting.

our teacher tells us what comes next
we can share news

topics.close: Starting each day with a meeting is a smart idea.

intro: Bees buzz around the flowers by our school.

intro: There are many ways to tell a story.

a drawing of a park can show many people

intro: Kids in other towns go to school, just as we do.

topics.close: Writing letters to another class would be great for us.

topics.close: Penguins are some of the most amazing birds in the world.
